pick.name: Google Play Data safety form + privacy policy + deletion path
pick.what: Mandatory Play Console declarations for every published app
pick.why: Required for Android (shipping now); a privacy policy link is mandatory even if you collect nothing

candidates.name: Apple App Privacy
candidates.verdict: When iOS ships (not verified this pass)

decision: Fill the Data safety form from your real SDK list (analytics, crash, auth), host the privacy policy on your site, and give users a discoverable deletion request (in-app or web form). Deleting/anonymising within 90 days lets you claim the deletion badge.
details: Play's separate account-deletion policy (web link + in-app) was not re-read this pass (unverified).

verify.note: Confirmed: a privacy policy is required even with no data collected, and the deletion badge applies if data is deleted within 90 days. Also confirmed: apps with account creation must provide BOTH an in-app deletion path and a web deletion link (answer 13327111), which resolves the note.
